landing.heroSubtitle: MChat combines a streaming bot engine, RAG knowledge base, skill plugins, and an embeddable widget — with 10+ LLM providers and multi-channel adapters. Built-in AI customer service workspace, extensible to patent search, medical, legal, and other vertical RAG workspaces.
landing.previewTitle: An embeddable vertical RAG platform, with AI customer service built-in
landing.previewSubtitle: The homepage, conversations, knowledge base, workspace configs, widget, and workspace settings are all real screens, not mockups. Use the live sites and screenshots below to understand the product quickly.
landing.previewPoint1: Manage AI conversations, knowledge bases, skill plugins, auto-sent assets, and vertical workspaces in one place.
landing.previewPoint2: Publish the same capabilities to your website widget, public showcase pages, and WeChat or other channels.
landing.previewPoint3: Useful for operations teams out of the box and flexible enough for developers to integrate and extend.
landing.liveSiteEnDesc: Primary English site for product positioning, UI preview, and widget experience.
landing.liveSiteZhDesc: Primary Chinese site for local demos, customer-facing walkthroughs, and business scenarios.
landing.previewFrameDesc: Show the product purpose first, then immediately reveal the actual admin, knowledge, and widget experience.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need for vertical RAG
landing.featuresSubtitle: From a single script tag on your site to enterprise-grade knowledge and skills.
landing.featureBotDesc: Streaming replies, tool calling, and skills — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, Ollama, Groq, and more.
landing.featureRagDesc: Import documents, chunk, embed with Milvus, hybrid search (vector+BM25+RRF) and reranking — inject relevant context into every answer.
landing.featureSkillDesc: Hot-reload SKILL.md packages from disk or zip — patent search, custom tools, and prompt skills. Premium skill packs for vertical workspaces.
landing.featureWorkflowDesc: ComfyUI-style graph editor, Skill DAGs, approval & merge nodes; schedules, workspace trigger rules, and patent report templates (Beta).
landing.featureWidgetDesc: One script tag adds a branded vertical RAG chat widget with streaming, themes, and per-workspace configuration.
landing.featureChannelDesc: Web widget, REST, WebSocket, WeChat Official Account — unified workspace config and knowledge base.
landing.featureTenantDesc: Independent workspace configurations with isolated AI configs, skills, knowledge bases, and welcome messages.
landing.archLine1: FastAPI backend · React admin · TypeScript widget
landing.archLine2: JWT auth · SSE streaming · Docker Compose
landing.footerTagline: Lightweight, embeddable, multi-tenant vertical RAG platform.

landingCloud.badge: Cloud SaaS · Ready to use · Industry templates
landingCloud.heroSubtitle: No servers to deploy. Pick industry templates, upload documents, and start chatting — reach users on your website, WeChat, IM, and support tools, with workflows and schedules.
landingCloud.previewTitle: Pick a template, add knowledge, go live
landingCloud.previewSubtitle: Choose an AI assistant for your industry, upload patents or FAQs, and use it in the chat workspace or on your website — no Docker or ops required.
landingCloud.previewPoint1: Patent search and customer-service templates with welcome messages and branding.
landingCloud.previewPoint2: One assistant across your website widget, WeChat, enterprise IM (DingTalk, Feishu, WeCom), and helpdesk — configure once, reuse everywhere.
landingCloud.previewPoint3: Pro unlocks skill orchestration: chain patent search, report generation, and schedules — run multi-dimensional patent reports in one click.
landingCloud.previewWorkflowSpotlightTitle: Skill orchestration: automate your patent workflows
landingCloud.previewWorkflowSpotlightDesc: Combine patent-search, report skills, and more in a visual graph. Save templates, run on a schedule or on demand — ideal for novelty search, comparison, and batch export.
landingCloud.previewWorkflowCaption: Search, export, schedule — build once, reuse anytime
landingCloud.featuresSubtitle: AI services for business teams — not a developer framework.
landingCloud.featureMarketDesc: Open patent search, customer service, and more with presets for prompts, knowledge bases, and trials.
landingCloud.featureRagDesc: Upload PDFs and docs; the AI answers from your materials, with patent search skills.
landingCloud.featureEmbedDesc: Website widget, WeChat, IM, and live support — embed code or API. Staff and visitors share the same knowledge and answers.
landingCloud.featureWorkflowDesc: Visually orchestrate patent search and report steps; schedules and approvals on Pro.

help.title: MChat Help
help.subtitle: Learn how to deploy, configure and use the MChat AI customer service platform
help.widgetDesc: Add this single line of code to any website to get a branded AI chat widget. Replace YOUR_AGENT_ID with the customer config ID from the admin panel.
help.widgetNote: When deploying to production, replace localhost with your actual domain and enable HTTPS.
help.kbStep1Desc: In Admin → Knowledge Base, create a new KB and configure chunk strategy, embedding model, and retrieval mode.
help.kbStep2Desc: Upload files (txt, pdf, md), paste text, or import from URL. Documents are auto-chunked, embedded, and indexed.
help.kbStep3Desc: In Customer Config, select which knowledge bases to use. The AI will automatically search the KB when answering.
help.kbStep4Desc: Adjust retrieval mode (vector/keyword/hybrid), reranking model, and query rewriting for best accuracy.
help.skillsItem1: Upload a zip package or install from URL (Admin → Skills → Upload/Install)
help.skillsItem2: Supports standard SKILL.md format with auto-parsed frontmatter metadata and prompt content
help.skillsItem3: Skills can be assigned to customer configs; multi-skill showcase panels are also supported
help.apiDesc: MChat provides a complete REST API for custom integrations. Visit /docs after starting the backend for interactive Swagger docs.
help.securityItem1: Change the default admin password — never use admin/admin123 in production
help.securityItem2: Set a strong random JWT_SECRET in .env (at least 32 characters)
help.securityItem3: Set up HTTPS reverse proxy (nginx/Caddy) — do not expose port 3001 directly
